players.bio: Adrián Martín Balboa Camacho (born 19 January 1994) is a Uruguayan footballer who plays as a striker for Argentine club Racing Club. Career Born in Montevideo, Balboa came from the youth divisions of Club Sportivo Cerrito, made his professional debut in the 0–1 loss against Villa Teresa on 24 November 2012.
Adrián Daniel Calello born May 14, 1987) is an Argentine football midfielder, who plays for CA Banfield.

Braian Alejandro Galván (born 6 October 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Banfield. Galván had a spell with Estudiantes in his youth career, which preceded him joining Colón.
David Zalazar (born 9th May 2002) is an Argentine footballer who plays as an Left Winger for Gimnasia LP.
Federico Marcelo Anselmo (born 17 April 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for San Martín SJ.

Neyder Stiven Moreno Betancur (born 9 February 1997) is a Colombian footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder. Currently plays for Atletico Bucaramanga Life and career Moreno was born on 9 February 1997 in Medellín, Colombia. He is a native of Medellín, Colombia. He attended Institución Universitaria Pascual Bravo in Colombia. He studied engineering. He has a daughter.

Nicolás Santiago Bertolo (born 2 January 1986) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for Banfield, on loan from River Plate, in the Argentine Primera División. His nickname is El Cordobes.
Nicolás Carlos Colazo (born 8 July 1990 in Buenos Aires), is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for Primera División club Gimnasia y Esgrima (LP).

Nicolás Meriano (born 9 November 2000 in Rosario, Santa Fe) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a central defender and his current team is Club Atlético Banfield of the Argentine Primera Division. Career Formed in the youth ranks of Club Atlético Belgrano, promoted to the first team in 2021.

Pedro Antonio Troglio (born 28 July 1965) is an Argentine football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is the current manager of Banfield. Playing career During his career as a footballer, Troglio played for River Plate, as well as at the 1990 FIFA World Cup with Argentina, where he scored a goal against the USSR.

Santiago David Esquivel (born 2 January 2004 in Buenos Aires) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Banfield. Career Oviedo grew up in Banfield's youth academy, with whom he signed his first professional contract on October 4, 2024. He made his debut on November 18, 2024 in the Primera División match lost 1-0 against Tigre.

Santiago López Garcia (born 4 December 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Banfield, on loan from Gimnasia y Esgrima. Career At youth level, López played for Club Banco Mendoza and Chacras de Coria. In January 2016, López moved to Israel to sign with Hapoel Afula's academy; having had a short stint with Beitar Jerusalem's.
Thomas Rodríguez Trogsar (born 5 April 1996) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a right midfielder for Uruguayan club Juventud Las Piedras.
